summary.text: Jermaine Decker, an independent write-in candidate and retired U.S. Army veteran, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. House in Iowa's 4th District to Chris McGowan.

paragraphs.text: Decker served in the U.S. Army from 2007 to 2015, earned a high school diploma from Logan-Magnolia High School, and is now retired.

In an August 2026 Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, he said he was running as an independent because Washington should answer to the people rather than to political parties or special interests, and that he was not running to become a career politician. He was on the ballot as a write-in candidate.
He campaigned against the two-party system and on fighting government corruption.
He lost to Chris McGowan, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
